verdict.rationale: Mistral is an API platform, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question here. The evidence does not show one: a probe of the standard spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) on docs.mistral.ai returned 404 for all of them. The llms.txt index and the human-readable API reference pages are not a machine-readable API specification.
